title: Find the display name and location of users who have obtained a badge, own
question: Find the display name and location of users who have obtained a badge, own at least one post that is well-finished (i.e., has a non-null ClosedDate), and whose total score across all their posts exceeds 500. Among these users, only include those whose highest-scoring post has a view count greater than 1000.

arguments.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055, u.XCL_058
FROM users u
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p WHERE p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052 AND p.XCL_044 IS NOT NULL)
  AND (SELECT SUM(p2.XCL_031) FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052) > 500
  AND (SELECT p3.XCL_030 FROM posts p3 WHERE p3.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052 ORDER BY p3.XCL_031 DESC LIMIT 1) > 1000
